  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Netherlands' largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Financial Services & Insurance. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Dutch financial institutions and insurers — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across the Netherlands, with a primary focus on Financial Services & Insurance, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for financial services and insurance institutions.

  3. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  4. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to regulated Dutch financial services and insurance organizations.

  5. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  6. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Dutch financial services and insurance sector, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures.

  7. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements

  1. 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  2. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  3. Well-connected in the Dutch financial services and insurance landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  4. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  5. Deep understanding of enterprise procurement and legal processes in the Netherlands, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  6. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  7. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  8. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  9. Native or full professional proficiency in Dutch; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the Netherlands with the ability to travel to client sites when required.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced, driven Strategic Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs' growth across the Netherlands' largest enterprises, with a specific focus on Government, Healthcare & Utilities. Our ideal candidate has a well-established network and a proven track record of selling to C-level and senior decision-makers at major Dutch public sector bodies, healthcare organizations, and utilities providers — and is passionate about the transformative possibilities of AI voice technology.

In this role you'll act as a strategic partner and trusted advisor, enabling clients to leverage our industry-leading models and ElevenAgents — our end-to-end platform for building and deploying AI voice agents — to reimagine their customer experience, internal workflows, and monetization strategies.

In this role you will:

  1. Build and manage a growing portfolio of strategic accounts across the Netherlands, with a primary focus on Government, Healthcare & Utilities, to help ElevenLabs meet its revenue goals.

  2. Identify new business opportunities where ElevenLabs' conversational AI capabilities, including ElevenAgents, can drive customer engagement, contact center automation, and operational efficiency for government bodies, healthcare organizations, and utilities providers.

  3. Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, building compelling business cases that translate AI voice technology into measurable business value for senior executives and economic buyers.

  4. Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the conversational AI landscape, including customer use cases, competitive solutions, and emerging trends, particularly as they apply to regulated Dutch government, healthcare, and utilities organizations.

  5. Demonstrate expertise, or a strong willingness to learn, about conversational AI and how ElevenLabs' voice technology can unlock value across customer support, virtual agents, IVR modernization, and in-app assistants.

  6. Develop and execute account strategies to expand ElevenLabs' presence within the Dutch government, healthcare, and utilities sectors, navigating complex procurement and organizational structures, including public tender processes.

  7. Partner closely with Customer Success, FDEs and Solutions Engineering to ensure smooth onboarding, deployment, and expansion of accounts.

  8. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, educating C-suite and senior operations leaders on emerging trends in generative AI, voice interfaces, and conversational agents.

Requirements

  1. 7+ years of quota-carrying strategic sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms.

  2. Proven success closing deals and managing long, complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders across business, IT, legal, and procurement.

  3. Well-connected in the Dutch government, healthcare, and utilities landscape, with an existing network of senior individuals and strong executive presence and ability to build relationships at the C-suite and board level.

  4. Experience selling technical solutions to product and engineering leaders; ability to translate complex technology into business value.

  5. Deep understanding of enterprise and public sector procurement and legal processes in the Netherlands, including tender and RFP processes, with the ability to accelerate deal velocity within complex organizational structures.

  6. Comfort operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment, including building new playbooks and iterating quickly.

  7. Passion for voice and audio AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers.

  8. A hybrid of customer and product-driven mentality that prioritizes client satisfaction and scale.

  9. Native or full professional proficiency in Dutch; strong English for internal collaboration.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the Netherlands with the ability to travel to client sites when required.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

• Proven track record of owning and growing a regional P&L.

We're looking for someone to join our Revenue Operations Team. This is the first dedicated compensation headcount in the team and will play a key role in scaling our compensation operations. This role sits at the intersection of operational rigor and cross-functional partnership, focusing on administering compensation programs, building scalable processes, and ensuring our GTM teams are paid accurately and on time.

As part of the Revenue Operations team, you'll collaborate with Legal, HR, Finance, and Sales Leadership to design and maintain the systems, workflows, and governance structures that power our variable compensation programs. This is an exciting opportunity to bring operational depth and analytical expertise to a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Process Design & Maintenance - Design and maintain scalable processes that support efficient compensation administration, including payout cycles, reconciliations, and operational close processes.

  • Compensation Administration - Administer compensation plans, quotas, credits, adjustments, exceptions, and payout processes, ensuring accuracy and consistency across GTM teams.

  • Governance & Compliance - Partner with Legal, HR, and Finance to support approvals, compliance, and audit requirements. Execute compensation letter generation, distribution, tracking, and record management.

  • Reporting & Analytics - Develop dashboards, reports, and quality assurance processes that improve visibility, accuracy, and trust in compensation programs.

  • Field Support - Manage compensation-related inquiries from GTM personnel, streamlining communication between field teams and back-office functions. Build and maintain support resources, FAQs, documentation, and intake processes.

  • 6+ years of Compensation Operations, Revenue Operations, or Finance Operations at high-growth technology companies

  • Demonstrated ability to build and improve scalable operational processes in high-growth environments.

  • Can break complex problems into smaller, actionable solution steps

  • Foundational analytical skills, with proven expertise in SQL

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

  • Highly adaptable, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.

  • Comfort balancing strategic context with day-to-day operational execution.

What we offer

  • High-velocity innovation: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • A truly global team: Collaboration with teammates across 30+ countries, a global customer footprint and office hubs in New York, London and Warsaw. Annual company offsite for the whole team to get together (the last one in Croatia!)

  • Remote first: We prioritize your talent, not your location, with structured asynchronous workflows for maximum impact and minimal meetings.

  • Continuous growth: Collaborate with AI leaders, shape your path, and contribute where you excel most.

  • Strong understanding of attribution, experimentation, ROAS, incrementality, and performance analytics

  • Excellent copywriting skills with an eye for memorable campaigns and high-converting, differentiated messaging.

  • Strong creative judgment and taste. You know what great marketing looks like and can work effectively with designers and creative teams.

  • Outstanding project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple cross-functional launches simultaneously.

  • Experience with lifecycle and loyalty marketing programs that improve acquisition and retention

  • Experience with performance marketing and affiliates

  • Curiosity about emerging distribution opportunities and the creativity to turn unconventional partnerships into scalable growth channels.

About the role

ElevenReader is our fast-growing consumer audio app, and creative is one of our biggest growth levers. We’re looking for a Creative Producer to deliver creative marketing campaigns, experiments, and to build the creative engine that powers performance marketing across every major acquisition channel.

This role sits at the intersection of creative design, AI, and performance marketing. You’ll be our lead creative strategist, producing high-quality creative concepts, building scalable creative workflows using AI tools, developing a testing roadmap, launching experiments across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms with our Performance Marketing team. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Design, Growth Analytics, and partner agencies to continuously discover which creative drives acquisition at scale, and feeding these insights back into future creative roadmaps.

This is one part strategist and one part creative producer for someone who loves combining exceptional creative taste with rigorous experimentation and marketing results.

What you will do

  • Designing creative systems, concepts and templates, mood boards, briefs, and AI workflows that power high-velocity ad production

  • Create visually-stunning, brand aligned, static ad campaigns end-to-end in Figma and ElevenLabs

  • Directing agency partners with clear and compelling creative briefs, UGC scripts, storyboards, scripts, and feedback on creative concepts, ensuring the timely and aligned delivery of assets

  • Creating and launching creative testing programs across Meta, Google, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging acquisition channels with Performance Marketing and agencies

  • Developing a structured creative roadmap with recurring testing sprints and clear learning agendas

  • Designing analytical frameworks to identify winning creative patterns using performance data and creative analysis

  • Researching and mapping creative trends across competitors, consumer categories, and best-in-class mobile apps to generate new hypotheses for testing

  • Partnering closely with Performance Marketing and agencies to rapidly iterate and scale winning campaigns

  • Continuously improving our creative production pipeline through AI automation, reusable templates, and scalable workflows

  • Analyzing which creative is resonating most with our audience through ad platforms and tools like Motion

  • Raising the creative quality bar while ensuring every asset is designed to maximize measurable business outcomes

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in performance creative, art direction, growth marketing, creative strategy, or design at a high-growth consumer product or technology company

  • Deep expertise with generative AI for image and video creation, with a strong understanding of how to build repeatable creative workflows with tools like ElevenCreative

  • Experience creating high-performing ads across Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, or other major paid acquisition platforms

  • Experience with creative performance analytics tools like Motion

  • Strong understanding of creative experimentation, performance marketing, A/B testing, and data-driven optimization

  • Expert proficiency in Figma, CapCut, Adobe Suite and modern AI creative tools and generative media platforms

  • Exceptional visual taste with the ability to balance speed, quality, and brand consistency

  • Deep understanding of user psychology and what drives successful consumer marketing

  • Highly analytical and structured thinker who enjoys building experimentation frameworks and extracting insights from data

  • Self-directed builder who thrives in fast-moving environments and can independently take ideas from concept to launch

Bonus

  • Power user of ElevenCreative, including Flows and Templates

  • Background in building AI-powered creative production systems or internal creative tooling

  • Passion for consumer products, AI, storytelling, and building globally loved brands.

Location

This role is remote with a preference for timezones in US - East and Europe

About the role

B2B Marketing at ElevenLabs is scaling fast - more in-person events, a growing lifecycle program, and rapid global expansion - and we need a dedicated marketing operations hire to build the infrastructure we need to keep up and enable the rest of the team to move faster.

This person will own our tooling and integrations, build automations around pre and post event promotion, maintain the health and segmentation of our marketing contact data, and the automation that accelerates global expansion. They need to work AI-first - dogfooding ElevenLabs in their own workflows - and are as comfortable wiring up low-code tools as they are vibe-coding a lightweight internal app to fill a gap.

What you will do

  • Event automations & tooling. As our investment in in-person events grows, build the infrastructure to scale it: maintain and develop our event lead-capture app, build and run event automations tied to Splash and Clay, automate pre-event promotion and rep enablement, and automate post-event follow-up.

  • HubSpot contact data & segmentation. Our lifecycle email is only as good as the data behind it. Enrich and maintain the HubSpot contact database, drive data quality, and build the segmentation that the lifecycle team activates. You own the data and segmentation layer - not the email sends themselves.

  • Global-expansion automation. Build automations that speed up our global rollout - for example, an automated pipeline that uses ElevenLabs to generate localized versions of performance-marketing creative and then routes them to the relevant geo leads for quality verification and approval.

  • Develop and iterate on content formats that drive engagement and show product capabilities to creators and marketers

Requirements

  • Prior experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, or revenue operations.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

We’re building a dedicated Strategic Accounts team to own ElevenLabs’ most important customer relationships in North America, and we’re looking for a high-impact Strategic Account Executive to be among the first hires.

This is a named-account role with a focused portfolio. You'll drive new business and expansion inside complex enterprise organizations, building multi-threaded executive relationships and positioning yourself as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders navigating real transformation - across customer experience, product, and operations.

These aren't transactional engagements. You'll architect custom solutions that combine our technology and services, collaborate cross-functionally to deliver measurable outcomes, and bring field intelligence directly into our product roadmap. You're not just executing a playbook - you're writing it.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and grow a focused portfolio of strategic accounts, driving both net-new business and expansion

  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies across business units, geographies, and use cases

  • Identify, scope, and close large, complex deals (multi-product, multi-region, custom solutions)

  • Build deep, multi-threaded relationships across executive, product, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Act as a strategic advisor, educating on emerging trends and shaping customers’ long-term AI roadmap

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Partnerships to deliver and expand

  • Translate patterns from bespoke deals into repeatable frameworks, offerings, and product insights

  • Feed learnings from the field into the product roadmap and broader strategic sales playbook

  • Drive creative outbound and high-touch engagement strategies (onsites, exec briefings, events)

Requirements

  • 6-10+ years of quota-carrying experience with a focus on strategic / enterprise accounts

  • Proven track record of closing and expanding seven-figure+ deals within named accounts

  • Experience leading complex, multi-threaded sales cycles across large organizations

  • Strong ability to drive land-and-expand motions and long-term account growth

  • Experience scoping consultative, custom deals that go beyond standard SKUs

  • Technical fluency - able to engage product and engineering leaders on APIs, integrations, and architecture

  • Executive presence with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and long-term strategy

  • Track record of translating customer needs into product feedback and roadmap influence

  • Creative, self-driven approach to outbound and pipeline generation

  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, ambiguous environment, building playbooks from scratch

  • Willingness to travel for customer engagements (onsites, QBRs, executive meetings)

  • Strong bias toward action, ownership, and leveraging AI in day-to-day workflows

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity to be the face and heartbeat of ElevenLabs’ Warsaw office! We are looking for a dedicated lead to anchor our Warsaw space. This office serves as the home for our rapidly growing Poland team and a central hub for the Poland AI community.

As our Warsaw Workplace Experience, you will be the "go-to" person for the Warsaw team, driving the office and culture. You’ll keep the daily logistics moving, assist with the launch of our new building in the heart of the city, and ensure our office is a place where people love to work. This role is perfect for a proactive, high-energy individual who enjoys being at the center of the action and wants to grow their career in a fast-paced AI company.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Be the Warsaw Hub: Serve as the primary point of contact for the local team and all new joiners, welcoming people to the space and ensuring everyone – staff, guests, and candidates – feels at home from day one.

  • Keep Operations Running: Manage daily logistics including post, communal areas, meeting room readiness, and vendor coordination (cleaners, catering, maintenance) to maintain a world-class environment.

  • Own the Office Culture: Drive the vibe of the space through snack and coffee selections, team lunches, birthday celebrations, and social rituals that make the office somewhere people love to be.

  • Support Events & Visitors: Help execute on-site events such as AI hackathons and evening meetups, while providing a warm and professional welcome experience for all external guests and partners.

Requirements

  • Based in Warsaw, able to be in the office 5 days a week.

  • Strong operational expertise in managing the day-to-day running of a high visibility office. Thrives in high pressure environments requiring solid judgement and quick decision making.

  • Experience acting as the primary point of contact for building management, coordinating with vendors, and overseeing office maintenance and supplies.

  • Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and legal partners to vendors and office guests, ensuring a professional and welcoming environment.

  • A proactive and forward-thinking approach, with a proven ability to anticipate needs, identify inefficiencies, and implement new processes to improve workflow in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in fostering a positive and productive office environment, including planning and executing office-wide events and negotiating with vendors to ensure high-quality service and cost-effectiveness.

Why this role?

This is a “foot in the door” at one of the world’s leading AI companies. You’ll have the autonomy to shape the local culture and the opportunity to learn office operations and facility management from the ground up as we scale our Polish presence.

Location

This role is based full-time at our Warsaw office, 5 days a week.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As the PE & Growth Investor Partnerships at ElevenLabs, you will build and scale one of our most strategic growth channels. You will own relationships with leading PE & Growth Investor firms, embed ElevenLabs into their Enterprise Value Creation programs, and drive AI adoption across portfolio companies.

Operating at the intersection of PE, Growth Investors, enterprise AI, & GTM, you will partner with Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, portfolio executives, and our Sales organization to source, accelerate, and close opportunities. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of BD & Partnerships & all regional GTM leads to define the strategy while owning execution across multiple PE & Growth Investor relationships.

Your success will be measured by your ability to build a scalable investor partner ecosystem that consistently generates enterprise pipeline and ARR.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 - 9 months, you will:

  • Launch the ElevenLabs Private Equity & Growth Investor Partner Program.

  • Recruit and activate 8–10 leading PE and growth investor partners, securing ElevenLabs’ inclusion in their Value Creation and portfolio engagement programs.

  • Build a repeatable GTM engagement model between investor operating teams and ElevenLabs to accelerate portfolio company adoption, pipeline generation, and deal velocity.

  • Establish a foundation for a scalable, partner-sourced ARR business.

Responsibilities

Private Equity & Growth Investor Partnerships

  • Build and manage executive relationships with Operating Partners, Value Creation leaders, and investment professionals across leading PE & Growth investor firms.

  • Structure and negotiate partnership agreements, joint GTM plans, referral models, and enterprise value programs.

  • Become the trusted AI partner for PE firms looking to accelerate value creation across their portfolio.

Portfolio Company Activation

  • Identify high-priority portfolio companies and develop joint account plans with PE operating teams.

  • Coordinate with Enterprise AEs, FDEs, Customer Success, and Product to drive AI deployments from initial introduction through production.

  • Help portfolio companies identify high-value AI use cases and accelerate adoption.

Pipeline & Revenue

  • Own pipeline generation and ARR sourced through PE partnerships.

  • Build and maintain a rolling portfolio company pipeline across assigned sponsors.

  • Drive executive introductions, accelerate deal velocity, and expand successful deployments across additional portfolio companies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to execute PE opportunities.

  • Develop repeatable GTM playbooks, executive engagement models, and portfolio-wide AI adoption frameworks.

  • Represent ElevenLabs at PE conferences, operating partner forums, and executive events.

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 8–12+ years of experience in Enterprise AI, Cloud, or enterprise software, with a focus on strategic partnerships involving Private Equity and Growth Investors.

  • Have experience working with PE firms, Growth Investors, Operating Partners, Value Creation teams, or PE-backed portfolio companies.

  • Have a track record of building strategic partnerships that generate measurable pipeline and revenue.

  • Have strong executive presence and can engage credibly with Managing Partners, Operating Partners, CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, and investment professionals.

  • Have successfully navigated complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.

  • Are comfortable discussing AI platforms and enterprise technology with both business and technical audiences.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and enjoy building new partnership motions from the ground up.

  • Are highly commercial, operate with urgency, and consistently create opportunities where none previously existed.

Location

This role is remote-first but NYC or London is preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're hiring an analyst relations manager for ElevenAgents in North America. We're looking for someone who has built an AR function from the ground up and knows what that program looks like once it's actually working – not just briefings on a calendar, but a real point of view that analysts trust and come back to.

Part of that point of view is getting analysts ahead of where ElevenAgents is taking the market – an enterprise-grade platform for deploying voice and chat agents at scale.

We already have a relationship with Gartner – the next phase is turning that into our first Magic Quadrant inclusion, and building that same muscle with Forrester and IDC as we expand coverage in 2027. You'll work directly with our Growth, Research and Field Deployment Engineering teams to understand what we're actually building, and turn that into a narrative analysts can act on.

Requirements

  • Experience running or building an analyst relations function, ideally in enterprise software, AI, or CX/contact center technology.

  • Direct, hands-on experience taking a company through a Gartner Magic Quadrant or Forrester Wave. You know what the submission process actually demands and you're ready to bring that same rigor to ElevenLabs.

  • Able to shape category narrative for a company that spans multiple product lines - helping analysts see how ElevenAgent – and eventually ElevenCreative, and ElevenAPI – add up to one coherent market position.

  • Comfortable prepping executives and technical leads for analyst inquiries and briefings, and building the cadence – newsletters, check-ins, event presence like Gartner IT Symposium – that keeps analysts current between them.

  • Bonus: experience covering agentic AI, voice AI, or conversational AI categories specifically.

Growth Potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Expand ownership from North America to a global analyst relations remit as we grow Forrester and IDC coverage in 2027.

  • Grow into a broader analyst and industry relations leadership role spanning ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative, and ElevenAPI as the function scales.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America with the ability to operate in PT or ET timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As Mid-Market Lead, you will be the strategic driver behind scaling and optimizing our Mid-Market AE organization. You’ll own revenue outcomes and team performance across our Mid-Market segment, with a strong focus on building repeatable, high-velocity sales motions. This role blends hands-on leadership with strategic execution in a fast-growing environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Define and execute the go-to-market strategy for U.S. Mid-Market accounts, including quotas, segmentation, and territory design.

  • Lead, coach, and scale a team of Mid-Market AEs, owning recruiting, onboarding, enablement, and performance management.

  • Own pipeline health and forecasting, driving consistency and improving conversion rates across each stage of the funnel.

  • Develop and refine sales playbooks, motions, objection frameworks, and deal models tailored to Mid-Market buyers and voice AI / conversational use cases.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, Growth, and Customer Success to align positioning, messaging, and expansion opportunities.

  • Establish feedback loops by synthesizing insights from prospects and customers to help inform GTM strategy and product roadmap decisions.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of SaaS or technology sales experience, with meaningful experience leading or scaling Mid-Market AE teams.

  • Demonstrated success surpassing revenue targets in a Mid-Market or velocity-oriented sales environment.

  • Strong command of sales metrics, funnel optimization, forecasting, and process rigor.

  • Experience selling technical, AI, or API-driven solutions to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across teams and seniority levels.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with high ownership.

Location

This role is remote across the US, with the option to work from our San Francisco or New York offices if preferred.

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As ElevenLabs continues to scale its global enterprise GTM motion, we're looking for a builder to define what world-class enablement looks like at that scale. You'll own the strategy behind how we turn every rep - AE, AM, and SDR, in every region - into a top performer: where we invest enablement time for maximum leverage, when and how we verticalize training by segment and geography, and which metrics prove the work is paying off in pipeline, revenue, and behavior change.

You'll lead a global enablement function spanning onboarding, technical and product enablement, and outbound enablement - setting the strategic direction and measurement framework that enablement function leads build and deliver against. You'll operate with full AI fluency, building automations applied directly to enablement workstreams and embedding AI fluency into the seller curriculum.

This is a new role focused on taking our enablement function to its next phase of growth. You'll design the systems, standards, and operating rhythm for enablement as we expand into new regions and segments. You'll partner cross-functionally - especially with the product marketing team that owns customer-facing assets - while you own everything that makes our sellers great internally: training, certification, and enablement infrastructure.

Requirements

  • 8+ years enablement leadership experience built around a technical product and a mature enterprise sales motion - you know how to enable sellers across multiple use cases, buyer types, and platform plays

  • Real sales experience of your own, plus hands-on experience building or working with AI agents and/or API tools - you speak credibly to what reps are actually selling

  • A track record building enablement strategy and measurement frameworks - defining and tracking performance indicators across AE, AM, and SDR teams

  • Experience scaling programs consistently across distributed, global teams and time zones

  • A builder's mindset - you're energized by defining a function's strategy, systems, and standards from the ground up

  • Bonus: experience leading or enabling a technical or field engineering motion in addition to a revenue motion

Location

This role is remote-first and can be executed from anywhere in the US or Europe, with the ability to operate across US and European time zones. You're also welcome to work from our offices in New York, San Francisco, London, Dublin, or Warsaw. Minimal travel is expected.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

As a Security Detection & Response Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be on the front lines of our security operations, playing a critical role in building and maintaining our detection and incident response capabilities. You'll have an automation mindset, constantly looking for ways to scale our security efforts and reduce manual work, leveraging frontier AI models. This role is perfect for someone passionate about security frameworks and best practices, driven by ownership, and eager to continuously improve our security posture. You’ll be instrumental in developing best-in-class security practices as we scale.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in incident response and security operations, including triaging security alerts, conducting investigations, and leading response efforts.

  • Strong background in detection engineering, including developing, tuning, and maintaining security detection rules and alerts.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM Infrastructure, specifically with Google SecOps (Chronicle). This includes data onboarding, parsing, rule creation, and dashboarding.

  • Proficiency in security monitoring across various platforms, including JAMF MDM for macOS endpoints, Google Workspace, Okta and general SaaS applications.

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring, particularly in Google Cloud (GCP) with familiarity in GCP Security Command Center (SCC).

  • Solid scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating detection and response tasks, data parsing, and security tooling integration.

  • Deep understanding of common attack techniques, threat intelligence, and the ability to translate them into actionable detections.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Cybersecurity Framework).

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to connect disparate pieces of information during investigations.

Location

This role is remote, so it can be executed from anywhere in the APAC region with the ability to operate in [GMT+10] timezones. We’re particularly looking for candidates based in Singapore, Australia or the Philippines.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is our consumer-facing music creation platform, built for music creators and professional musicians alike. We want ElevenMusic to have a voice, a community, and a content presence that matches the ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Content Creator & Strategist to own that presence. You will make music with the platform every day, push it to its limits, and turn what you discover into educational content, tutorials, and social posts that teach creators what's possible. You will own the ElevenMusic social accounts, build and energise the community around the product, and represent ElevenMusic on stage at creator events.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of music creation, content, and community. The right person is a genuine music maker who lives on social platforms, has strong opinions about how an AI music brand should show up, and is just as comfortable behind a mic or on stage as they are in an editing timeline. Because you'll be using the product harder than almost anyone, you'll also be a critical feedback loop into the engineering team, shaping the product itself.

What you will do

  • Create educational content and tutorial videos around ElevenMusic — recording, editing, and formatting them natively for each platform and publishing them across our socials

  • Make music with ElevenMusic constantly, testing the platform to its limits and turning experiments into content that shows creators what's possible

  • Provide structured, high-signal product feedback to the engineering team based on deep daily use, helping shape the roadmap

  • Own and manage the ElevenMusic social accounts, from content calendar and strategy through to publishing, engagement, and analytics

  • Help build and grow a community around ElevenMusic, sparking conversation, surfacing creator feedback, and championing standout work

  • Speak at creator events, representing ElevenMusic through talks, demos, and workshops

  • Plan and execute content around product launches and feature releases, coordinating with product, engineering, and marketing teams

  • Stay ahead of trends in music creation, AI tools, and platform culture to find opportunities for the brand

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience creating content, with a portfolio of work you can share

  • Proven ability to produce educational content and tutorial videos end-to-end: recording, editing, adding text and motion, and formatting natively for platforms like X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube

  • Experience managing social media accounts for a technology, music, or creative tools company, including content calendars, copywriting, and analytics

  • Comfortable presenting publicly — speaking at events, running demos or workshops, and being a visible face for the product

  • A genuine understanding of the AI and music creation landscape — you use the tools, follow the space, and have informed opinions about where things are headed

Bonus

  • Experience managing social for a music-related product

  • Experience running or growing a community channel such as Discord

  • Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar)

  • Experience building a social presence from early stage or leading a rebrand on social

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

  • Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

  • Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves

  • End-user support: handle inbound support requests and be a friendly first point of contact for the team

  • Comfort with common IT fundamentals (macOS, networking basics, SaaS tooling)

  • A willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • Prior experience in a high growth / startup environment

  • Experience in a customer or public-facing role

  • Familiarity with bash scripting

  • We offer competitive compensation and stock options. We are open to candidates of varying seniority. Given the broad range, we'll be happy to discuss specific salary details during our initial conversation.

  • Annual company off-sites; the last ones were in Croatia, Portugal and Switzerland.

This position will be 4 days on-site in our San Francisco office.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring an Affiliate Marketing Manager to build and scale our affiliate and partner-led referral program from the ground up. This is a largely untapped channel with enormous upside given our creator, developer, and enterprise reach. You’ll own strategy and execution end-to-end—recruiting and activating partners, designing commission and payout structures, standing up tracking and attribution, and driving profitable, scalable revenue through the channel.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who has built or scaled an affiliate program before. You’re as comfortable recruiting and negotiating with partners as you are in the tracking, attribution, and unit economics. You obsess over partner quality, incrementality, and fraud control, and you know how to turn a network of affiliates into a durable revenue engine. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with creative, lifecycle, landing-page, product marketing, finance, and legal.

What you will do

  • Build and own the affiliate/partner program strategy and execution across self-serve, developer, and creator segments

  • Recruit, onboard, and activate affiliates, publishers, and creator partners

  • Design and optimize commission, payout, and incentive structures to drive profitable growth

  • Stand up tracking, attribution, and fraud/quality controls so affiliate impact is measurable and clean

  • Partner with creative and lifecycle on affiliate assets, landing pages, and promo copy

  • Manage partner relationships, performance reviews, and ongoing enablement

  • Move fast: test partner cohorts and offers, analyze performance, iterate quickly, and document learnings

  • Partner with finance and legal on payouts, agreements, and compliance

Requirements

  • Proven track record building or scaling an affiliate/partner program that drove measurable revenue

  • Hands-on expertise with affiliate/partner platforms (Impact, PartnerStack, Rewardful, Tune, Everflow, or similar) and tracking/attribution

  • Strong analytical chops—you understand attribution, incrementality, and LTV vs payout math without needing a second opinion

  • Experience recruiting, negotiating with, and managing affiliates, publishers, or creator partners

  • Skilled at designing commission structures and controlling for fraud and low-quality traffic

  • Clear communicator with the ability to write high-intent copy and brief creative

  • You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building a program from the ground up

Bonus

  • Experience with creator/influencer partnerships in addition to traditional affiliates

  • Experience marketing to technical audiences (e.g., developers, APIs, infrastructure)

  • Familiarity with both self-serve and sales-led motions

  • Experience standing up reporting systems or collaborating with data/BI teams

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

As a Security Detection & Response Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be on the front lines of our security operations, playing a critical role in building and maintaining our detection and incident response capabilities. You'll have an automation mindset, constantly looking for ways to scale our security efforts and reduce manual work, leveraging frontier AI models. This role is perfect for someone passionate about security frameworks and best practices, driven by ownership, and eager to continuously improve our security posture. You’ll be instrumental in developing best-in-class security practices as we scale.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in incident response and security operations, including triaging security alerts, conducting investigations, and leading response efforts.

  • Strong background in detection engineering, including developing, tuning, and maintaining security detection rules and alerts.

  • Hands-on experience with SIEM Infrastructure, specifically with Google SecOps (Chronicle). This includes data onboarding, parsing, rule creation, and dashboarding.

  • Proficiency in security monitoring across various platforms, including JAMF MDM for macOS endpoints, Google Workspace, Okta and general SaaS applications.

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring, particularly in Google Cloud (GCP) with familiarity in GCP Security Command Center (SCC).

  • Solid scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) for automating detection and response tasks, data parsing, and security tooling integration.

  • Deep understanding of common attack techniques, threat intelligence, and the ability to translate them into actionable detections.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks and best practices (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, NIST Cybersecurity Framework).

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail and the ability to connect disparate pieces of information during investigations.

Location

This is an in-country role with a strong preference for a candidate in London.

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in Canada. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in Canada, your work will shape how Canadian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

What you'll do

  • Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Canada's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

  • Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

  • Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Canadian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

  • Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

  • Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

  • Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

  • Deep knowledge of the Canadian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

  • Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

  • Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact.

  • Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out.

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and organic search and our website are among the most important sources of new users and customers at the company.

That organic engine was built primarily for our Creative Platform and self-serve users. This role builds the B2B one.

We are looking for a B2B SEO/AEO Lead to own organic growth for the business buyer across everything we sell — our Agents platform, our developer and API products, and our enterprise offering. Agents is the most immediate opportunity and where you would start, but the mandate is the whole B2B surface: the low-volume, high-intent keywords business buyers actually search, the pages and content that capture them & our visibility inside ChatGPT, Gemini and other answer engines.

This is a hands-on, highly autonomous role. You will do your own keyword research, build and improve pages yourself, vibe code the tooling you need, write and direct content, and analyse your own impact.

The right person has done SEO for a B2B software company where the goal was pipeline rather than sessions. You are comfortable justifying a page with modest search volume because you know what those visitors are worth, and you are as comfortable with the AI search surface as with Google. You use AI as your primary means of production, and you have a quality bar high enough that it never shows.

What you will do

  • Own the low-volume, high-intent keyword universe for our B2B products — starting with Agents, then across API and enterprise

  • Own AEO and the approach to measuring it effectively

  • Build and ship pages yourself and with the help of growth engineers, including programmatic page sets across verticals, use cases and comparison intents

  • Turn new product launches, use cases and customer stories into pages, FAQs and content, working directly with our product marketing managers

  • Help direct the B2B half of our content calendar with our Growth Content Writer

  • Build the reporting that makes B2B organic impact legible, and report it in pipeline

Requirements

  • Experience owning SEO for a B2B software company

  • Strong keyword judgment at the bottom of the funnel

  • Hands-on and independent: comfortable working with AI tools, vibe coding, improving existing tooling & shipping fast

  • Real, current experience improving visibility in AI search

  • Comfortable with content: you can write, brief and edit to a high standard

Bonus

  • Programmatic SEO at scale

  • Experience marketing to both developers and business buyers

  • Experience in voice AI, CX, contact centre, or developer tools categories

  • Experience working alongside a B2B sales team and translating buyer conversations into content

  • Multi-language and international SEO

  • A portfolio of side projects, automations or programmatic sites you have launched

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own B2B organic growth as a function, with a team of writers and page builders

  • Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic and AI search across all of ElevenLabs

  • Expand into broader ownership of the B2B growth funnel

  • Take ownership of company-level acquisition and pipeline metrics

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

ABOUT THE ROLE

That organic engine was built primarily for our Creative Platform and self-serve users. This role builds the B2B one.

We are looking for a B2B SEO/AEO Lead to own organic growth for the business buyer across everything we sell — our Agents platform, our developer and API products, and our enterprise offering. Agents is the most immediate opportunity and where you would start, but the mandate is the whole B2B surface: the low-volume, high-intent keywords business buyers actually search, the pages and content that capture them & our visibility inside ChatGPT, Gemini and other answer engines.

The right person has done SEO for a B2B software company where the goal was pipeline rather than sessions. You are comfortable justifying a page with modest search volume because you know what those visitors are worth, and you are as comfortable with the AI search surface as with Google. You use AI as your primary means of production, and you have a quality bar high enough that it never shows.

 - Own the low-volume, high-intent keyword universe for our B2B products — starting with Agents, then across API and enterprise

 - Build and ship pages yourself and with the help of growth engineers, including programmatic page sets across verticals, use cases and comparison intents

 - Turn new product launches, use cases and customer stories into pages, FAQs and content, working directly with our product marketing managers

 - Help direct the B2B half of our content calendar with our Growth Content Writer

 - Build the reporting that makes B2B organic impact legible, and report it in pipeline


REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience owning SEO for a B2B software company

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring an Automations Engineer to build the systems that run our influencer and creator marketing program at scale. As the program grows, nearly every step—discovery, onboarding, contracts, content tracking, reporting, and payments—can be automated. You’ll own that automation layer end-to-end: designing, building, and maintaining the workflows and integrations that let a lean team manage thousands of creators without manual busywork.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder who is equally comfortable in no-code and low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n) and writing custom code (Python or JavaScript) against APIs. You think in systems, care about reliability and clean data, and get satisfaction from replacing a manual process with a workflow that just runs. This role is highly cross-functional and will partner closely with the influencer/creator team, marketing ops, finance, legal, and data/BI.

What you will do

  • Creator discovery: build automations that query social platforms and databases for profiles matching brand keywords and follower thresholds

  • CRM data sync: automatically push new influencer profiles and contact details into the team’s database

  • Onboarding: send automated welcome packets, brand guidelines, and brief templates when a creator joins

  • Contract generation: auto-fill creator names, dates, and payout rates into legal templates from form data, and route for e-signature

  • Content reminders: trigger automated Slack messages or emails to creators before posting deadlines

  • Content tracking: use APIs to log when an influencer posts and capture live links automatically

  • Data aggregation: pull views, likes, comments, and clicks from social APIs into a central dashboard

  • Report generation: produce weekly and monthly performance spreadsheets without manual data entry

  • ROI calculation: compute cost-per-engagement and conversion rates automatically for each campaign

  • Invoice processing: route creator invoices to finance systems once content is verified as live

  • Payment status alerts: send automated notifications to finance and creators when payments process

  • Build and maintain the integrations and webhook triggers that connect social platforms, CRM, finance, Slack, and e-signature tools

  • Own reliability: error handling, monitoring, secrets management, and audit trails so automations run cleanly and securely

  • Validate and troubleshoot data (SQL) and document workflows so they stay maintainable as the program scales

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building automations with no-code/low-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python or JavaScript) for custom logic and API work

  • Experience integrating APIs and building webhook-driven workflows across marketing, CRM, and finance systems

  • SQL proficiency for data validation and troubleshooting

  • Systems thinking with strong attention to reliability, error handling, and clean data

  • Comfort with secrets management, authentication, and basic security and audit practices for automations

  • Clear communicator who can partner with non-technical marketing, finance, and legal stakeholders

  • You thrive in scrappy, high-ownership environments and are confident building systems from the ground up

Bonus

  • Experience with influencer/creator marketing platforms (CreatorIQ, GRIN, Upfluence, Aspire, or similar)

  • Experience with social platform APIs (TikTok, Instagram/Meta, YouTube)

  • Experience with e-signature (DocuSign) and payment/finance integrations (PayPal, Stripe, Bill.com, or similar)

  • Familiarity with data warehouses and BI tools

  • Experience using AI/LLMs to build or accelerate automations

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.


#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the Role

We are looking for a Paralegal to join our Legal team and support the Company's growing international entity portfolio. The ideal candidate will have experience in international subsidiary management, a strong understanding of corporate law, and experience leveraging technology to efficiently maintain corporate records.

In this role, you will:

  • Coordinate the formation of new international subsidiaries, including preparing and organizing incorporation documents, organizational document amendments, notary and apostille requirements, state and local filings, and foreign qualifications.

  • Assist with M&A deal execution, including organizing data rooms, tracking closing checklists, and coordinating document signatures.

  • Own the global compliance calendar by proactively tracking filing deadlines, tax registrations, board meeting requirements, and government submissions across all entities.

  • Ensure entities remain in good standing by coordinating required filings through outside counsel, corporate service providers, and entity management platforms.

  • Maintain corporate governance records, including director and officer information, constitutional documents, signatory registers, and formation files.

  • Support the onboarding and day-to-day use of the Company's entity management platform.

  • Serve as a key point of contact for entity-related requests from internal and external teams across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Manage and work together with members of the Legal, Finance, People, and other teams on the Company's corporate governance matters, including constitutive documents, filings, business permits, and Board and shareholder documentation.

  • Manage the signature coordination and filing of vendor contracts across the organization .

  • Coordinate with external counsel and other stakeholders to gather and provide necessary information for Company projects and transactions.

Who you are

  • Excited about AI and eager to work at a company building at the frontier of the technology industry.

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams across jurisdictions and time zones.

  • The kind of person who follows up without being asked and flags issues before they become problems.

  • A clear communicator who can work effectively with outside counsel, internal teams, and service providers across cultures and geographies.

  • Hunger to be exceptional at your job.

What you bring

  • At least 3 years of experience in a corporate paralegal, entity management, or legal operations role.

  • Experience supporting entity formations, corporate filings, or corporate governance processes.

  • Familiarity with coordinating across multiple jurisdictions and working with international outside counsel or service providers.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working with AI tooling and a willingness to build with it.

  • Exposure to M&A transaction support.

  • Paralegal certificate or equivalent professional training is a plus.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed from anywhere in the world, but candidates based in New York, San Francisco, or London are preferred.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the most advanced AI audio platform in the world. Millions of creators, developers, and businesses use our products, and our website is one of the company’s most important sources of new users and subscriptions.

We are looking for a Growth Engineer to work at the intersection of engineering, product, data, and business. You will build and optimize the experiences that help users discover ElevenLabs, understand its value, and become active customers.

This is a highly autonomous role focused on measurable outcomes. You will identify growth opportunities, form hypotheses, build and launch experiments, analyze the results, and decide what to do next. You will work across conversion-rate optimization, organic search, programmatic pages, onboarding, web performance, and experimentation infrastructure.

Organic search and our website are major drivers of new signups and subscriptions at ElevenLabs. Engineers on this team have the opportunity to generate significant business impact through rapid experimentation, improvements to high-traffic pages, and systems that scale successful ideas across thousands or millions of search intents.

The right person is a strong product-minded engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working with data, and owning problems from initial idea through implementation and measurable impact. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a funnel, discussing an experiment with design, building the solution, and evaluating whether it worked.

What you will do

  • Identify and build opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and revenue

  • Own growth experiments from hypothesis through implementation, instrumentation, launch, analysis, and iteration

  • Build and improve high-traffic product pages, landing pages, onboarding experiences, and programmatic page systems

  • Improve technical SEO, crawlability, structured data, internal linking, page quality, and website performance

  • Collaborate with design, SEO, product, data, marketing, and frontend engineering to turn successful experiments into scalable systems

Requirements

  • Strong experience building production web applications using React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies

  • Experience independently taking projects from an initial idea through launch and measurable impact

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify friction, form hypotheses, and prioritize opportunities

  • Experience working with analytics, funnels, experimentation, SQL, and product or business metrics

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy, shipping quickly, and collaborating across engineering, design, product, data, and marketing

Bonus

  • Experience working as a Growth Engineer, Product Engineer, startup founder, or early-stage engineer

  • Experience building programmatic SEO systems or scaling large numbers of landing pages

  • Experience with technical SEO, experimentation platforms, feature flags, or A/B testing

  • Experience improving onboarding, activation, monetization, referral, or sharing flows

  • A portfolio of side projects, products, automations, or experiments you have launched

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Own a major acquisition, activation, or monetization area across ElevenLabs

  • Lead the strategy and technical direction for organic growth, conversion, or experimentation

  • Build and lead a larger Growth Engineering function

  • Expand into broader product engineering or growth leadership

  • Take ownership of company-level growth metrics and cross-functional growth initiatives

Location

This role is remote and can be executed from the US East Coast or Europe, with sufficient working-hour overlap with the broader team.

You may also work from one of our offices, including London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw, and other ElevenLabs locations.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
